channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jimmer Fredette | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jimmer Fredette from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jeff Teague on Jimmer Fredette
item.description:
Jeff Teague, who is a former NBA player, says that he watched Team USA and thinks his BIG3 squad could've beaten them.

“I’ve seen Jimmer Fredette and that team, we would’ve beat them, if you let us practice. Because they practice for that s—t. You don’t really practice for the BIG3, you go the day before, you get some shots up and you go play,”

Jeff Teague on Jimmer Fredette, Aug 5, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Jimmer Fredette
item.description:
KC Johnson:Thibodeau on Fredette:

“I don't want to pre-judge him defensively. I want to see how he picks things up.”

Tom Thibodeau on Jimmer Fredette, Mar 2, 2014. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Pete D'Alessandro on Jimmer Fredette
item.description:
The Sacramento Kings and guard Jimmer Fredette have mutually agreed to a contract buyout, according to Kings General Manager Pete D’Alessandro.

“This was a very tough decision, but we’re confident that the agreement reached today represents the most productive path forward, both for Jimmer and the Kings,”

Pete D'Alessandro on Jimmer Fredette, Feb 27, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Chris Jent on Jimmer Fredette
item.description:
“Well, I think with Jimmer it’s stated, and I think it’s probably accurate for any player, is that he knows he’s gonna play,”

Chris Jent on Jimmer Fredette, Jan 18, 2014. Source: Cowbell Kingdom.

item.title: Pete D'Alessandro on Jimmer Fredette
item.description:
Fredette still remains perhaps the most popular King even though he hasn't consistently been in the playing rotation since joining the Kings as a first-round pick in 2011.

“With Jimmer, we spoke to him and his representatives throughout the process,”

Pete D'Alessandro on Jimmer Fredette, Nov 2, 2013. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Darius Johnson-Odom on Isaiah Thomas, Jimmer Fredette
item.description:
“I look at their roster. I figure out teams, like Sacramento. The one question I had (for the Kings) was what made Isaiah Thomas so much better than Jimmer Fredette?… They gave me feedback.”

Darius Johnson-Odom on Isaiah Thomas, Jimmer Fredette, Jun 8, 2012. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Brandon Jennings on Jimmer Fredette
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Jennings on Jimmer Fredette:

“He's a better shooter than I am right now. I don't know why he wouldn't want to come work out here.”

Brandon Jennings on Jimmer Fredette, Jun 10, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Greg Miller on Jimmer Fredette
item.description:
Ross Siler:Greg Miller on Jimmer:

“If he's the best player available when it's our turn to pick, we're going to have to take a hard look at him.”

Greg Miller on Jimmer Fredette, May 2, 2011. Source: Twitter.
